lead: `setPassword` on a deleted entry makes Samba close the connection
body: , and every later call on that connection throws `Unavailable`, and so does a call on a second `Core\Ldap::connect` of the same block in the same program. Samba drops the session and sends no error. A proof that tries it makes it the last step, and deletes its own unit before that step, as `tests/hostile/core/Ldap-Entry/isDeleted/01-use-a-deleted-account.nvs` does.
